personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, trustworthy, and native-feeling operations dashboard anchored by earthy moss greens and warm sand tones—prioritizing clarity and financial transparency.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list items should feel comfortable to tap. Utilize native iOS spacing rhythms with 'lg' or 'xl' safe area padding.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use frosted glass overlay for sticky headers above scrollable ledger or property lists.
Use glassmorphism on floating action buttons (FAB) over a brandTertiary tint.
dont's: Never apply glass to dense statistical tables or small chips.
Do not use glass for text input backgrounds.

screens.name: Auth Flow (Owner & Tenant)
screens.purpose: A seamless entry point utilizing email + Aadhaar OTP verification to build immediate trust.

states.error: Inline text below input or non-intrusive toast.

screens.layout: Hero image covering the top 40% of the screen (building facade). The login form sits in a card overlapping the bottom edge of the image with a subtle gradient scrim. Large typography for 'Welcome to Rentify', single column input for email/Aadhaar, sticky Continue button above keyboard.

screens.name: Owner Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides the property owner with a high-level overview of revenue, unit occupancy, and urgent actionable items.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean room, prompt to 'Add your first property'.
states.error: Error card with a prominent Retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: Bold typography displaying 'Revenue this Month' on a primary brand card. Below it, a 2-col flex grid for 'Occupied Units', 'Vacant Units', and 'Pending Rent' using solid surfaceSecondary cards. Bottom section: A vertical list labeled 'Today's Actions' (Overdue rent, maintenance requests, expiring leases) with >56pt touch targets and chevron indicators.

screens.name: Tenant Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Reassures the tenant with clear next steps regarding rent, alongside important notifications.
screens.layout: Prominent Hero card showing 'Next Rent Due' with amount and date, featuring a sticky primary CTA to 'Pay Rent via Razorpay' positioned inside the card. A list of recent notifications and a quick link to the Maintenance Ticket system below.

screens.name: Tenant Ledger
screens.purpose: A chronological, highly scannable timeline of payments, charges, and refunds.

states.empty: Icon illustration of keys with 'No transactions recorded yet'.
states.error: Unable to fetch ledger data, tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header (frosted glass) with total balance. Scrollable list of transactions. Each row features a tinted icon container (brandTertiary), transaction title, date (muted), and the amount (formatted in bold). Use color coding sparingly—only for negative/pending balances.

screens.name: Maintenance Ticketing
screens.purpose: Full ticketing system for reporting and tracking property issues.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty room, 'No open maintenance requests'.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Open/In-Progress/Resolved). Scrollable list of cards. Each card displays an image thumbnail, title, date, and a pill-shaped status chip. Floating Action Button (FAB) (glass over brandTertiary) at the bottom right to 'Create Ticket'.

screens.name: Security Deposit & Expenses View
screens.purpose: Track deposits, deductions, refunds, and operational expenses in a transparent tabular format.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'No expense records found'.

screens.layout: Summary card at the top displaying Total Deposit / Total Expenses. Below, a chronological list of deductions and reasons, identical in structural rhythm to the ledger. Expense tracking allows a sticky primary CTA at the bottom to 'Log Expense'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided (NO blues, purples, or magentas). Apply the moss green and warm sand tones strictly across all components.
Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean' spacing scale: utilize generous vertical breathing room. Do not cramp lists or stat cards.
Ensure 'brandPrimary' is used sparingly—only for Primary CTAs, active tab indicators, and critical highlights. The app canvas should primarily be 'surface' and 'surfaceSecondary'.
For text rendered on top of imagery (e.g., the auth hero image), you MUST implement a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern using expo-linear-gradient as outlined in the guidelines.
For the Owner Dashboard, structure the 'Today's Actions' section using a list rhythm (leading visual/icon + title + chevron) with a minimum 56pt tappable height per row.
For the Tenant Dashboard, ensure the 'Pay Rent' CTA is highly visible and sticky when appropriate.
Wire haptics to all primary button presses and tab changes as detailed in the haptics object.
Use Phosphor icons consistently at weights 400 or 500. Avoid mixing filled and outlined states except in the bottom tab navigation.
